notAvailable.title: Not on Yalla right now
notAvailable.body: This place's page is closed for now. Their phone and door still work.

notFound.title: We could not find that place
notFound.body: Check the link — it may have been mistyped, or the place may have changed it.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Check your internet. The page will open as soon as the connection is back.

error.title: Something went wrong on our side
error.body: Nothing you entered is lost. Try again in a few seconds.

stale.offline: No connection — what you see may be out of date.
stale.error: Could not refresh — what you see may be out of date.

room.empty: This place has not mapped its tables yet.

legend.unavailable: Not for this time or party

room.noneHere_one: No free table for {{count}} guest in this room at this time. Look at the other rooms or pick another time.
room.noneHere_other: No free table for {{count}} guests in this room at this time. Look at the other rooms or pick another time.
room.failed: We could not load the room.

menu.ownLanguage: The menu is written in the venue's own language.

hours.zone: Times are in the {{zone}} time zone.

branches.title: Choose a branch
branches.later: Later times may still be free
branches.empty: This venue has not added a branch on Yalla yet. Try again a little later.

booking.notOffered: Booking through Yalla is not switched on for this venue. The room below is live, and the menu and hours are up to date.
booking.overlapsOwn: You already have a booking here at {{time}} (table {{table}}). Change or cancel that one first.
booking.overlapsOwnPlain: You already have a booking here at {{time}}. Change or cancel that one first.
booking.overlapsOwnOn: You already have a booking here on {{date}} at {{time}} (table {{table}}). Change or cancel that one first.
booking.overlapsOwnOnPlain: You already have a booking here on {{date}} at {{time}}. Change or cancel that one first.
booking.otherDate_one: Pick a date (up to {{count}} day ahead)
booking.otherDate_other: Pick a date (up to {{count}} days ahead)
booking.bigPartyAsk_one: For more than {{count}} guest, ask the venue directly.
booking.bigPartyAsk_other: For more than {{count}} guests, ask the venue directly.

noTimes.dayToday: Today's daytime times have passed. Pick the evening or another day.
noTimes.day: No daytime times on this day. Pick the evening or another day.
noTimes.evening: No evening times on this day. Pick the daytime or another day.

table.prompt: Tap a free table on the room photo, or let us choose.
table.noneFits_one: No free table for {{count}} guest at this time. Try another time.
table.noneFits_other: No free table for {{count}} guests at this time. Try another time.
table.lost: Table {{label}} is not free with these choices. Pick another.
table.checking: The room is still loading. Try again in a moment.
table.roomFailed: We could not load the room, so we cannot choose a table for you yet.

booking.timesUnchecked: We could not check which times are free. Pick a time, and the room will show what is free then.
booking.timeNotOffered: Your current time is no longer offered. Pick another time to change the booking.

done.addCalendarBody: So your own phone reminds you. Needs nothing else.
done.getAppBody: The app adds the two things this page cannot: a reminder before your table, and cancelling in one tap.
done.manageBody: Keep this link. It works without an account, on any device.
done.lateCancellation: Cancelling less than {{window}} before is still allowed — recorded as late, never refused. The venue would rather know than hold an empty table.

manage.title: Your booking
manage.freeUntil: Free cancellation until {{day}}, {{time}}. You can still cancel later — the venue will just see that it was late.
manage.freePassed: The free-cancellation time has passed. You can still cancel — the venue will see that it was late.
manage.cancelFailed: We could not cancel that. Try again.
manage.cancelledBody: The table has gone back to the venue. Thank you for telling them.
manage.declinedBody: The venue could not take you at that time.
manage.pastBody: This visit is over. Thank you for choosing {{venue}}.

changing.intro: Pick another day, time, number of guests or table. The venue may need to confirm the change.
changing.unchanged: This is your booking as it stands. Change the day, the time, the guests or the table.
changing.pending: Changed. The venue needs to confirm the new time — this page will show the answer.

error.account: This booking can no longer be changed online. Call the venue, or cancel it and book again.
error.overlapsOwn: You already have a booking at this venue around then. Choose another time.
error.commandInUse: That try could not be used. Press “Save the change” again.
error.busy: Someone is booking that table this second. Press “Save the change” again.
error.rateLimited: Too many tries with this link just now. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.notAccepted: The venue is not taking bookings online right now. Your booking is unchanged.
error.tableGone: That table is no longer available. Pick another.

changing.putBack: The venue could not take the change. Your booking stays at {{when}}.

gone.title: This link no longer works
gone.body: The booking may already be over, or the link was copied wrong. If you are not sure, call the venue.

manage.cancelledByVenueBody: The venue cancelled this booking. Call them if you have a question.

reviews.who: Only guests who came here through Yalla can leave a review.
reviews.failed: We could not load the reviews.

title.taken: This table is no longer free
title.name: Last step

table.agree: I will free the table by {{time}}, so the next guests do not have to wait.
table.agreeFirst: Tick the promise above to continue
table.lateOk: Cancelling later is possible too; the venue simply sees it.

taken.body: Table {{label}} was just booked by someone else. Your day, time and guests are kept: choose another table.
taken.none_one: No other table is free for {{count}} guest at this time. Look at the room, or choose another time.
taken.none_other: No other table is free for {{count}} guests at this time. Look at the room, or choose another time.

phone.body: The number is only needed to hold the table, so the venue can reach you. It is not published.
phone.telegramNote: Fastest with Telegram: one tap, no code to type.
phone.telegramOnly: Confirm with Telegram: one tap, no code to type.
phone.short: Write the whole number, for example 77 123456
phone.smsOff: Codes by SMS are not available right now. Confirm with Telegram instead.
phone.noDoors: Confirming a phone number is not available right now. Try again later.
phone.loading: Checking how we can confirm your number…

telegram.body: In Telegram, press Start, then share your number. This page carries on by itself once the number is confirmed.

name.label: Name for the booking
name.hint: The venue will ask for this name at the door.
name.notePlaceholder: For example: a birthday, a high chair, an allergy

done.linkHint: Keep it to change the time or cancel. We do not send emails.
